# LLMReady

> An open-source AI compatibility auditor. Classify a site into one of six profiles, sample up to eight pages, then validate /llms.txt, RFC 9309 robots.txt, static HTML signal-to-noise and profile-specific schema.org metadata.

## Product

- [Audit workspace](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox#readme): Classify a site, run the 20-check audit matrix against a deterministic page sample and inspect line-level fixes.
- [Site score vs page score](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox#site-score-vs-page-score): The origin-scoped score, deterministic sampling and the `scope=page` fallback.
- [Site classification](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox#site-classification): The six profiles and the signals behind them, with manual override.
- [Scoring model](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox#scoring-model): The checks the audit enforces, with pass conditions.
- [API](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox#api): `GET /api/audit?url=example.com` returns the full JSON report, including `classification`, `coverage` and `focusPage`.

## Developer tools

- [CLI](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox#cli): `llm-seo-toolbox example.com` runs the same audit with table, JSON, markdown or summary output and CI-friendly exit codes.
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox#github-action): Audit a deployment on every pull request, keep one sticky report comment current and fail the job below a score or grade threshold.
- [Workspace packages](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox#workspace-layout): `@llm-seo-toolbox/core` is shared by the web app, CLI and action.

## Standards

- [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/): The manifest structure this project validates.
- [RFC 9309](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9309): Robots Exclusion Protocol.
- [schema.org](https://schema.org/): Structured data vocabularies used by the audit.

## Machine-readable

- [OpenAPI description](https://llm-seo-toolbox.vercel.app/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 schema for `GET /api/audit`.
- [Sitemap](https://llm-seo-toolbox.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Canonical pages on this deployment.
- [Robots policy](https://llm-seo-toolbox.vercel.app/robots.txt): RFC 9309 rules with named AI crawler groups.
- [Security contact](https://llm-seo-toolbox.vercel.app/.well-known/security.txt): RFC 9116 vulnerability disclosure details.
- [Expanded context](https://llm-seo-toolbox.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): The full audit model in one request.
